incidents.name: HYDT MintV2 spot-priced minting
incidents.notes: HYDT's MintV2 mints HYDT against BNB valued at the WBNB/USDT pair spot price, so the attacker moved that pool inside a flash loan and minted HYDT far below its backing.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xA2268Fcc2FE7A2Bb755FbE5A7B3Ac346ddFeDB9B created 2024-01-05T10:22:36Z by 0xb6573ef29de48bb7ceaf6dafed51756073d71fcc, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x4645863205b47a0a3344684489e8c446a437d66c; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
